Name: Less Blue Blue Ribbon
Author: willowmods
Description:
[center]﻿﻿I'm obsessed with the blue ribbon added by 1.6, but I have a desperate need to match my accessories to my clothes, and just one colour is far too restrictive, so I created this mod!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FsFjkbzM/Rose-Ribbon.png[/img]﻿

These ribbons do not replace the original, they're added in as new items. The config file will let you toggle on and off which ribbons are available at the hat mouse, so make sure to edit it to your tastes! You're also able to choose when the ribbons go up for sale.



P.S.
Feel free to let me know if there's any colours you'd like me to add!


[/center]

Manifest.Name: Less Blue Blue Ribbon
Manifest.Description: Makes the blue ribbon available in different colours.
Manifest.Author: willowmods
